belief: Small steady steps can help someone every day.
title: Mooshika Tiny Helper Band
subtitle: Wear a reminder that small steps can become kind action.

steps: Colour the helper band and the little step symbols.
Cut along the outer cut line.
Write one tiny helpful action you will do today.
Wrap the band around your wrist and tape the ends.
content.take_it_today: Wear it until you do one tiny helpful action for someone.

geometry.band_text: I CAN TAKE TINY HELPER STEPS

wisdom.statement: Mooshika reminds us that small steady steps can make a big difference.
wisdom.today: Choose one tiny helpful action and do it before the day ends.
